title: How Jenn Rosa spent her P1-million winnings from ‘Rainbow Rumble’
summary: Jenn Rosa shared that she donated a significant amount of her P1-million win from Kapamilya gameshow “Rainbow Rumble” in 2025 to her church and Save the Children Philippines.
